summary: Canada filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for a proposed offering of USD-denominated bonds due in 20XX. The bonds are direct, unconditional obligations of Canada payable from the Consolidated Revenue Fund, with semi-annual interest and collective action clauses requiring 75% holder consent for modifications. Underwriters will purchase all bonds if any are purchased. The offering is a routine sovereign debt issuance, not a special situation. What to watch: final pricing and settlement date.
